title: Grateful Dead Live at Field House, U. of Cincinnati on 1970-04-03
lineage: SBD > ? >  bootleg CD > pitch correction and retracking > SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a stellar 1970 show featuring the first-ever Candyman, strong Pigpen moments and standout Good Lovin'/Lovelight performances.
ai_review.review: This recording delivers a solid soundboard mix that is clear for its era, with only occasional buzzing in the acoustic set. Musically it’s a highlight‑filled night – Jerry sings sweetly on Deep Elem Blues and Black Peter, Pigpen shines on Candyman, Good Lovin' and Lovelight, and the band’s interplay throughout makes it a must‑hear vintage performance.

ai_rating.rationale: All eight reviews are 4–5 stars, praising both the musical execution and the generally good sound quality; minor recording quirks keep it from a perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall clear and well‑pitched soundboard tape with occasional buzzing in the acoustic set; strong for the era and praised as 'strong' and 'pretty good' by multiple reviewers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Rare early‑show acoustic set opens with Candyman and other first‑time performances, followed by a tight mid‑set featuring Good Lovin' → Lovelight; overall pacing is praised as cohesive and historically significant.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Sweet vocal delivery noted on Deep Elem Blues and Black Peter; playing described as very good.
band_member_comments.Phil: Amazing bass work, locked in with Jerry throughout the performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s rhythm guitar/vocals receive praise for honoring Pigpen during Good Lovin' and Lovelight.
